title: Pixel art, shaders, audio and level editing in one workspace
author: Coffeboii4real
selftext:
I just tried this new app for my pixel art game and here my review

Isberg Labs puts a lot of the game-dev workflow in one Windows app: sprites, animation, modeling, scenes, audio, shaders and code. It also supports local MCP for connecting your own client.

The interesting part is having those editors together. The screenshot shows the Pixel & Animation editor used to create sprites for OVERGROWN.

Would having these tools in one workspace make your workflow easier, or do you prefer a separate app for each job?

It was found on 

https://isberg.itch.io
